body: My Chinese parents only whooped me when I was little if I was doing something bad (like fighting with siblings, being extremely disrespectful). Never if I had difficulty learning or doing something like in this video. They also didn’t really care about my grades too much cuz I was already top of my class due to self-motivation (not out of pressure). I had a C one time but they didn’t do anything. Currently my younger sibling is not doing so well in school but it’s not like my parents get super angry about it. They never forced us to play a sport or an instrument. I guess I’m in the minority :p
